answer: A graduated earning spiral pays a new identity 10% first, adding 10 points per epoch of verified work to 100% at epoch ten. A hollow shell doing no work never climbs, so empty farms stay at the lowest rate. Steps are logged in the public juniper register; only one verified task per identity per epoch advances it. Thus 1,000 fakes need 1,000 task loads per epoch, the thousandth costing as much as the first, idle-clone farms reset to 10%, and one honest identity keeps the full share after ten epochs.
